title: SolidBit Project Registry Specification v1
description: Local authority configuration for registered projects, canonical filesystem roots, and concurrency policies. Packages identify registered projects but cannot redirect execution outside local registry policy.

project_id.description: Unique stable identifier for the registered project matching manifest 'project' property

target_local_repo.description: Authoritative local filesystem root path for this project. Packages cannot redirect execution to arbitrary paths outside this registered root.

allowed_worktree_base.description: Subdirectory or absolute base path where agent worktrees are provisioned

allowed_target_roots.description: Explicit whitelist of authorized filesystem roots. Package-requested target paths must reside within this whitelist.

allow_target_override.description: When false, package requests targeting paths differing from target_local_repo are strictly rejected by policy.

concurrency_policy.description: Project-level concurrency controls and lock limits

max_mutating_jobs.description: Maximum concurrent mutating jobs allowed for this project. Baseline is strictly 1.

allow_concurrent_read_only.description: Whether read-only operations (monitoring, inspection, preflights) may run concurrently with a mutating job

risk_tier.description: Risk categorization governing required gate approvals

enforce_dirty_root_check.description: Whether to enforce the Local Dirty-Root Rule before worktree provisioning

active.description: Whether this project is active and accepting execution jobs

description.description: Human-readable summary of the project and its operational role
